landing.gap_title: Your broker's P/L is not your P/L.
landing.gap_sub: Three things every broker app gets wrong for a Spanish investor.
landing.gap_b1: Your app converts at today's rate. Hacienda wants the ECB rate on the day of each transaction. Across a multi-year dollar position, that gap is real money.
landing.gap_s1: Every leg — buy, sell, dividend, fee — converts at the ECB rate for its own date. Weekends resolve to the prior business day.
landing.gap_b2: You see current positions, not which lots you actually sold — so you can't tell what a sale owes.
landing.gap_s2: Sales match the oldest lots first (art. 37 LIRPF). Realized gains per year, net of commissions.
landing.gap_p3: Tax is your problem in April.
landing.gap_b3: The two-month rule, foreign withholding, the Modelo 720 line — none of it is in your broker app.
landing.gap_s3: All three computed and flagged automatically.
landing.fifo_note: Oldest lots first — art. 37 LIRPF. The gain of the sale is fixed by lots 1 and 2, not the average.
landing.fx_note: The second number is the tax basis. It is usually not the one your app shows.
landing.how_title: Three steps to your real number.
landing.step1_body: Ten seconds, no password, no card.
landing.step2_body: Every parsed row is previewed before anything is written. Nothing lands in your ledger without your say-so, and any import can be undone in one click.
landing.step3_body: Positions, EUR P/L, allocation, risk, realized gains, dividends and tax all come from that one ledger. No second data entry.
landing.prov_title: We show you where every number comes from.
landing.prov_body: Every KPI carries a reliability tag. {fact} means verifiable in an SEC EDGAR filing. {consensus} means an analyst aggregate — an opinion, and labelled as one. {derived} means computed here from the statements, and only as good as the inputs. When a number isn't available it renders n/a. It is never invented and never quietly swapped for a worse one. Where a common metric is known to be unreliable — yfinance's PEG, for one — we say so on the page instead of printing it as fact. The moat score says it plainly: a screen, not a verdict.
landing.f_portfolio_body: Allocation by sector, geography and currency. Top-5 concentration and effective number of names (1/HHI). Annualised return and volatility, max drawdown, beta vs SPY / QQQ / EEM, return-correlation heatmap. And the chart most trackers skip: true time-weighted return, flow-adjusted so your own deposits stop counting as performance, plotted against a fixed-weight backtest of today's holdings.
landing.f_tax_body: IRPF savings base across the 19/21/23/27/28 % brackets, losses netted and carried forward four years, the two-month rule applied automatically, foreign withholding split into the treaty-creditable part and the reclaimable excess, and a Modelo 720 flag at the €50,000 line.
landing.f_ai_body: Every message carries your live book, so “am I too concentrated in tech?” is answered from your numbers. Fifteen analysis lenses, optional web search with linked sources, and it can act — set an alert, tag a position. Free tier included, or bring your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini key.
landing.f_deep_body: Moat score across five weighted pillars, open-market insider buying and selling from SEC Form 4, P/E against the company's own history rather than a peer average, and a comps table that ranks your peer set.
landing.f_earnings_body: A calendar of your watchlist, and on every past print a full breakdown: revenue and trend, margins with year-on-year bps, the GAAP result, headline EPS reconciled to GAAP diluted, the price reaction across the gap, and next quarter's consensus with its analyst dispersion.
landing.f_alerts_body: Nine rule types: price above or below, daily move, drawdown from high, RSI either way, SMA cross, new 52-week high or low. Checked hourly on market days.
landing.f_telegram_body: An evening portfolio digest, and the same assistant with the same live book and the same conversation thread as the panel in the app.
landing.f_crypto_body: BTC-EUR pairs alongside equities, a display currency of EUR, USD, GBP or CHF, everything normalised underneath. Tax figures stay in euros, because Spanish fiscal rules are euro-denominated.
landing.depthA_title: The euro number your broker won't show you.
landing.depthA_body: A share bought in dollars in 2022 and sold in 2025 has two exchange rates in its life, and Hacienda cares about both. TopStocks converts every leg at the ECB rate published for that leg's own date, caches the history, and resolves weekends to the prior business day. That is the tax basis, not spot — and it is usually a different number from the one in your broker app.
landing.depthB_title: Built for the IRPF, not adapted to it.
landing.depthB_body: FIFO under art. 37 LIRPF, with acquisition cost including buy commissions and proceeds net of sell commissions. The savings-base brackets. Losses netted and carried forward four years. A loss auto-deferred when you repurchase homogeneous shares inside two months (art. 33.5.f) — the rule most spreadsheets forget. Dividend withholding split into the part Spain credits and the excess you can reclaim. And a warning when foreign holdings clear the €50,000 Modelo 720 line.
landing.depthB_disclaimer: A planning aid, not tax advice. The logic is unit-tested; your circumstances are yours. Check with your gestor before filing.
landing.trust_title: Free, and you can read exactly why.
landing.t1_b: The whole thing is public. Read what it does with your data instead of taking our word for it.
landing.t2_h: We never touch your broker login.
landing.t2_b: You upload a statement file. No credentials, no aggregator, no read-access to your account.
landing.t3_b: Data is keyed to your verified Google email and isolated per account. Nothing crosses between users. Even company logos are served from our own domain, so no third party learns which tickers you look at.
landing.t4_b: Bring your own and you pay your own provider bill. Tick Remember and it's encrypted and auto-expires in fifteen days; otherwise it never leaves the session.
landing.t5_h: No ads, no data selling, no upsell.
landing.t5_b: It's free because it's a personal project, not because you're the product.
landing.faq_a1: Yes. MIT-licensed, no card, no paid tier.
landing.faq_a2: Revolut (CSV or PDF), Revolut crypto, Trading 212, DEGIRO, Interactive Brokers, ClickTrade / Saxo (XLSX or CSV), plus a generic CSV schema and manual entry for anything else.
landing.faq_q3: Do you connect to my broker account?
landing.faq_a3: No. You upload a statement file. TopStocks never sees your broker credentials.
landing.faq_q4: Can I try it without an account?
landing.faq_a4: Yes. Home, Ticker, Screener and Calendar work signed out on a starter watchlist. Allocation, Import and Profile need a sign-in because they're your private data.
landing.faq_q5: Where does the data come from?
landing.faq_a5: Prices from Yahoo Finance, filings from the SEC EDGAR API, FX from the ECB via frankfurter.dev.
landing.faq_a6: No, and it doesn't pretend to be. The judgement stays yours.
landing.faq_a7: It's a planning aid. The FIFO and IRPF logic is unit-tested, but check with your gestor before filing.
landing.faq_a8: Both, switchable anywhere in the app.
